body:
In article <TeyJ4.5460$NS6.141018@news.globetrotter.net>,
  "Fischer" <gibby@globetrotter.net> wrote:
>  ... Actually, I don't Ted had much INFORMATION on the Jews. You have
> to remember
> that he lived in the middle of nowhere and his main source of
> information
> was a tiny public library.
>
> If you read his manifesto, you'll see that his ideology is very much
> to the
> right of the political spectrum, and he opposes everything that the
> Jews
> stand for in today's society. While I agree with you that the Jewish
> question shouldn't be the only topic of discussion here, it is
> nonetheless
> an issue that has to be addressed. ...

It seems to me that anyone who wishes to remain on topic would do so by
addressing a particular ideology embraced or rejected by the
Unabomber.  Of what legitimate relevance (to this news group) is it
that another group embraces or rejects the particular ideology?

> ... 15. Leftists tend to hate anything that has an image of being
> strong, good and successful. ...
> 16. ... The leftist is anti-individualistic, pro-collectivist. He
> wants society to solve everyone's needs for them, take care of
>  them. He is not the sort of person who has an inner sense
>    of confidence in his own ability to solve his own problems and
> satisfy his own needs. ...
>    18. Modern leftist philosophers tend to dismiss reason, science,
>    objective reality and to insist that everything is culturally
>    relative. It is true that one can ask serious questions about the
>    foundations of scientific knowledge and about how, if at all, the
>    concept of objective reality can be defined. But it is obvious that
>    modern leftist philosophers are not simply cool-headed logicians
>    systematically analyzing the foundations of knowledge. They are
>    deeply involved emotionally in their attack on truth and reality.

Individual freedom, not folks who embrace the Jewish faith, is the
subject matter.  The leftists' influence upon America is seen as a
threat to individual freedom.  The religion embraced by the leftist (or
anyone else) is irrelevant.

Before you buy.
